record_status: RETROSPECTIVE. This pool was built before the amendment, so no invocation was captured at build time. Fields that describe the build PROCESS are therefore UNRECOVERABLE and are marked as such rather than reconstructed. Fields that describe the pool ITSELF are read from the pool and its manifest and are exact. Blocks named *_at_record_time were MEASURED when this file was written and describe the repository now, NOT the repository at build time.

cause_established_by_falsification.consequence: The pool is REPRODUCIBLE, but only against the pre-v2.3.1 sampler, not against the shipped one. Under the shipped sampler the admission filter is inert at the eval clearance floor (bypassing it entirely gives the same sha as leaving it in), so these pools were admitted under a materially stricter -- and dimensionally wrong -- rejection radius than the shipped code applies.
controls_that_did_not_reproduce_it: goal clearance floor forced to the start's floor
cause_established_by_falsification.finding: This pool was built with the PRE-v2.3.1 form of the unavoidable-collision admission filter (src/envs/scene_init.py::_passes_unavoidable_collision_filter). That form charged the projected DISTANCE dot(unit(velocity), center - start) into the v^2/(2a) stopping term; the shipped form charges the projected SPEED dot(velocity, unit(center - start)) -- the v2.3.1 unit fix noted in-source at scene_init.py:634-638. Reverting ONLY that one expression, with nothing else changed, reproduces this pool's recorded sha256 EXACTLY.

reproducibility_at_record_time.divergence_character: Not numeric drift: the rebuilt pool differs from the recorded one in the SCENE CONTENT itself (start, goal, obstacle centres/radii/active), i.e. the rejection-sampling stream desynchronises. First differing scene index: 3 for both n2000 pools and for eval_inloop_di_n500_seed12345, 0 for eval_inloop_unicycle_n500_seed12345. The same mismatch appears whether the rebuild loads base_config alone or base+exp merged, so the cause is SAMPLER CODE, not the loader choice.
